summary: Wrote a six-phase implementation plan for sharing one verify-deploy gate run per /orchestrate batch. The design splits into Mechanism A (a dispatch-time batch-gate deferral directive emitted by orchestrate-build-dispatch.sh, which never edits a plan's own tier field) and Mechanism B (a new once-per-invocation orchestrate-batch-gate.sh stage at the Move 4/5 seam that runs the full gate once and attributes findings per task via deploy-baseline-lib.sh's existing deploy_baseline_self_attributable_findings). Planning surfaced one coupling the research report missed: phase-closure.md's no-promotion-without-evidence rule must be carved out or Mechanism A is inert, so it is now a Phase 1 target. The plan validates clean under validate-artifact.sh.

artifacts.summary: Six-phase plan: tier vocabulary and contract carve-outs, invocation-scoped per-task modified_files accumulator, dispatch-time deferral directive, the shared batch-gate stage script, engine wiring and registration, integration verification under the complete gate set.
